title: A Perilous Departure
description: While the battle with the Guavian Death Gang and Kanjiklub rages on, Han and Chewie get closer to the Millennium Falcon, but not without impact. A blast hits Chewbacca in the shoulder. Han takes Chewie's bowcaster and fires at the oncoming gang members, managing to hold them off long enough for Rey, Finn and BB-8 to get aboard the Falcon.
